name: elastic stiffness

name: maximal elastic stiffness
notes: Upper cap of load-dependent k_e at alpha_max=R*. Computed from Hertz tangent (eq25). = our k2_hat interpolation analog.

name: plastic stiffness
our_mapping: (plastic-branch slope; no LIGGGHTS direct slot - hooke is ~linear)
notes: Plastic loading branch slope (line CD

name: plastic-cohesive (pull-off locus) stiffness
notes: Slope of LINEARIZED pull-off locus f_cp=-k_cp*alpha_cp+f_0p (eq18). Negative. EEPA k_adh analog (2-param point with f_0p).

name: first-contact adhesion (jump-in)
notes: Jump-in attraction = (8/9)*f_ce. = JKR pull-off times 8/9. EEPA f_0 analog (constant adhesion).

name: linear pull-off intercept
notes: Force-axis intercept of linearized pull-off locus (eq18).

name: interface/surface energy
notes: JKR f_ce=-3/2*pi*R*Gamma. Sweep for e-v curves (Fig6). MPM --coh / adhesionStiffness mapping basis.

name: reduced radius
notes: Validation particle-to-plane so R*=R_particle=2.45um.

name: Young modulus (validation particle)
notes: Validation particle. Si wall E=182 GPa. nu=0.3 both. Soft vs our SE (real 24 / soft 1.35).

name: contact yield pressure
notes: Used only to locate alpha_y/f_y (Thornton[24]/Johnson[25]). NOT capped in plastic branch -> NOT path A.

name: sensitivity bed size
notes: Die 12mm dia

name: JKR elastic pull-off (point B)
notes: Point B (elastic pull-off). Jump-in f_0 = 8/9*f_ce; break at 5/9*f_ce.

name: elastic loading branch (BC)
notes: alpha<alpha_y. Reversible (unload same line). Below B drops with -k_e to alpha_fe (force 5/9 f_ce).

name: plastic loading branch (CD)
notes: alpha>=alpha_y. Plastic deformation; k_p slope. = our contact plasticity branch (no pressure cap).

name: elastic unloading from D (DE)
notes: alpha_p = unload force-zero overlap = PERMANENT plastic overlap = our epsilon_sphere displaced material.

name: adhesive branch beyond pull-off (EF)
notes: Below alpha_p to pull-off f_cp (point E); break at 5/9 f_cp. Re-establish at alpha_c0 with 8/9 f_cp.

name: plastic flattening deformation
notes: Pure plastic overlap after yield onset; drives load-dependent pull-off.

name: work of adhesion (plastic area)
our_mapping: Stage-E plastic contact-area x surface energy
notes: ENERGY-CONSISTENT coupling: pull-off from plastic flattened area A_p times Gamma. = our Stage-E area used for adhesion instead of transport.

name: work of adhesion (unloading area)
notes: Same adhesion work as area under unloading response (Appendix I

name: load-dependent pull-off force
notes: Pull-off grows with plastic deformation alpha_pd (eq10=eq11). Fig4 curve. Nonlinear; linearized in eq18.

name: impact energy balance
notes: Plastic + elastic-compressive + pre-yield-elastic - initial-cohesive-loading work.

name: critical sticking velocity
notes: Elastic strain energy = adhesion work -> contact does NOT break (max sticking impact velocity).

name: rebound velocity
notes: Used with eq17 (v_i) to get e=v_r/v_i.

name: linearized pull-off locus
notes: 2-PARAMETER linear fit of eq12 (only for deformation > 6% of particle radius
column9: Fig9). = justification of our linear-coefficient cohesion.

name: simplest-model plastic loading
notes: Fig10 simplified model: drop elastic BC branch (plastic-dominant materials). Unload eq20 (k_e)

name: load-dependent elastic stiffness
notes: Same form as Luding eq1/eq8 interpolation. Prevents k_e<k_p at small deformation. NEEDED for high-velocity e decrease (Fig13->14).

name: critical sticking velocity (validation particle)
notes: Proposed linear model reproduces TN critical sticking velocity = linear-approx-nonlinear evidence.

name: critical sticking velocity vs Gamma
notes: Gamma up -> v_s up (stronger adhesion sticks more). k_e=1500 k_p=210.

name: critical sticking velocity vs k_e
notes: k_e up -> v_s up. k_p=210 Gamma=0.02.

name: critical sticking velocity vs k_p
notes: k_p up -> v_s up. k_e=1500 Gamma=0.02.

name: restitution asymptote (constant k_e)
notes: Constant k_e gives unphysical high-v plateau ~0.38; load-dependent k_e (eq25) gives e decrease (TN-consistent).

name: plastic-work saturation
notes: Above k_e/k_p~20 almost all input work is plastic. k_e/k_p=1 still plastic>elastic (rearrangement/friction).
